authority: Readable Segoe UI typography plus docked non-overlapping canvas tool/layer chrome

font.fallback: Macroquad built-in font is allowed only on the startup bootstrap splash before Windows Segoe UI is initialized; normal editor UI remains Segoe-first.

rules: Segoe UI remains the intended default editor typeface
Only the bootstrap startup splash may use fallback text before Segoe UI is ready; normal editor UI never does
The layer rail may not cover rulers, toolbars, or editable canvas content
The layer rail and tool rack own explicit pointer hit areas
Selecting a layer remains non-destructive and does not arm Paint or Place
